title: Code of Conduct
label: Code of Conduct
author: The VIIV Community Council
description: The values and standards that keep our builder community safe and honest.

chapters.title: Respect and Safety
chapters.description: A space where every builder can take risks.
chapters.body:
Every builder deserves a space where they can take risks. Harassment, discrimination, and intimidation have no place on campus.

If you see something that makes someone unsafe, say something. Reporting is a responsibility, not a betrayal. Every report is handled seriously, confidentially, and without retaliation.

chapters.title: Honesty in Work
chapters.description: Credit others, report real numbers, build your own.
chapters.body:
Credit others for their ideas, report your real numbers, and never pass off someone else's build as your own.

The point of a portfolio is proof — and proof only counts if it is true. When in doubt about whether to credit someone, credit them.

chapters.title: Community Care
chapters.description: The community is as strong as the builders who look out for one another.
chapters.body:
When you see a problem, speak up. The community is only as strong as the builders who look out for one another.

Celebrate wins loudly and give feedback generously. A builder community that cares for its own will outlast any single project, cohort, or demo day.
